title: InvisibleArmor: Vanilla & Mods
description: A small resource pack that makes any armor worn by the player invisible.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65f5b3810e0daff08e5cf01c33c6dfeb139dfde5.png)
**This is just an example, in the game the armor is completely invisible.  
[I will be very grateful if you subscribe to Lena's OPG | Textures.](https://t.me/lenaopg)**

## **How does it work?**
- **It's very simple: Every armor texture (except the one that uses the 3D model to display in the inventory) has been replaced with a transparent pixel with a resolution of 1x1.**

In the future, I plan to update this set and add support for more modifications.

## **This can it boost FPS?**

- **In theory, this is possible if you are on a large server with many players at one point. Or, if you use modifications with complex armor models (Example: Botania and addons to it).**

**Note**: Unfortunately, not all modifications can work correctly without armor textures, known ones include Draconic Evolution and some armor from TechGuns. Perhaps I'll make a separate list with incompatibilities.

## Supported mods:

### **1.7.10:**

- **Minecraft (Vanilla)**
- **IndustrialCraft 2**
- **DivineRPG**
- **TechGuns**
- **ThermalFoundation**
- **TheTwilightForest**
- **ThaumicTinkerer**
- **GraviSuite**
- **Avaritia (Wings not retracted, player not glowing)**
- **LoliEnergyRelics (Wings not retracted, player head glowing)**
- **Netherlicious**
- **Witchery (Bark belt not retracted)**
- **Botania**
- **Alfheim**

### **1.12.2:**

- **Minecraft (Vanilla)**
- **IndustrialCraft 2**
- **DivineRPG**
- **TechGuns**
